assay: fitness factor = total insertion counts in the inoculum / total insertion counts in the lung (a RATIO, not a log)
native_convention: greater than 1 = mutant depleted from the lung = gene required
transformation_to_in_vivo_effect_log2: in_vivo_effect_log2 = log2(kppr1_lung_fitness_factor); emitted only where the ratio is finite and strictly positive
significance_kind: CEDER P (Fisher-combined per-insertion exact Poisson tests); floors at 0 for the strongest genes
direction_probe_used_to_confirm_the_sign: the paper's five experimentally validated fitness genes (rfaH, ilvC, ilvD, copA, aroE) have median ratio 203.6 against a genome median of 1.007; arithmetic check Count_Inoculum/Count_Lung reproduces the ratio exactly
